column1: # The names of AutoHotkey v1.1.37.02 that this tree does not carry yet.
# The tree carries the whole of the v2, so the pending table of the v2 is
# empty. The v1 has names that the v2 does not have, and those are pending
# until the v1 dialect lands.
# A name that is about a Windows API is not listed here: the tree carries
# the Windows-shaped names of the v2 and refuses them with the reason, and
# the v1 will do the same.
# kind      command, function, variable or directive
# class     the class a method belongs to, empty otherwise: the v1 has no
#           runtime classes, and the column is empty for every row
# name      the name, as the v1 spells it
# reason    why the tree does not carry it yet
# The reasons:
# not-yet   the name is here, and it is still to do.
# The names come from the table of the surface of the v1
# (ahk-v1.1.37.02.surface.tsv), which was measured on the binary on
# 2026-10-29, and the names that the v2 does not have were read out of the
# table of the v2.
# What the table held before the 2nd of November of 2026, and what the
# tree carries now:
# - The twenty-nine built-in variables of the v1 that the v2 does not have
#   are carried: twenty-seven of them answer with the value that the binary
#   answers, and the two of them that are about the machine (`A_OSType` and
#   `A_IPAddress1`) are refused with the reason.
# - The fifteen directives of the v1 that the v2 does not have are carried:
#   the `#NoEnv` and the `#Persistent` are the case that the runtime already
#   is, and the other thirteen are refused with the reason.
# - The seven names of the v1 that the tree answers with a handler of their
#   own are carried: the `IsSet`, the `IsFunc`, the `IsByRef`, the `Object`,
#   the `Func`, the `FileReadLine` and the `Input`. Their answers were
#   measured on the binary of v1.1.37.02 on 2026-11-02.
# - The `AutoTrim` is carried: the command turns the trim of the text of a
#   legacy assignment on and off, and the `A_AutoTrim` says which one is in
#   force. Measured on the binary of v1.1.37.02 on 2026-11-02.
# - The `SetFormat` is carried: the command turns the format of the numbers
#   of the v1, and the `A_FormatFloat` and the `A_FormatInteger` say the
#   format that is in force. Measured on the binary of v1.1.37.02 on
# - The `StringCaseSense` is carried: the command turns the sense of the case
#   of the comparisons on and off, and the `A_StringCaseSense` says the one
#   that is in force. Measured on the binary of v1.1.37.02 on 2026-11-02.
# - The `Transform` is carried: the command answers the math of the v1, and
#   the `VarSetCapacity` answers the capacity of a variable. Measured on the
# - The `IfInString`, the `IfNotInString`, the `IfMsgBox` and the `Else` are
#   carried: the commands of the v1 that have a body run their action when
#   the condition holds, and the `Else` is the action of the other side.
#   Measured on the binary of v1.1.37.02 on 2026-11-02.

command
